deliverables.name: configuration_guide_claude_api
deliverables.content: To configure Claude API for Baukjen, first connect your Shopify store to the Claude API platform using the API key provided in your account settings. Then, create a new project and select the 'Fashion Product Description' template. Next, upload a product image and enter a few bullet points to serve as input for the AI writing assistant. Finally, customize the generated product description to fit Baukjen's brand voice and style.
deliverables.instructions: Configuration guide for Claude API, ranked #1 for this business.
